items.source:
Note that this class does not take specifics of Spring AOP or
any other framework arrangement into account. It just operates
on the JDK and CGLIB proxy facilities and their core conventions.
items.translation: 注意，该类不考虑 Spring AOP 的具体细节或任何其他框架的架构。它仅基于 JDK 和 CGLIB 代理设施及其核心约定进行操作。

items.source:
Register a proxy hint for a JDK proxy or corresponding reflection hints
for a CGLIB-generated subclass, if necessary.
items.translation: 如有必要，请为 JDK 代理注册代理提示，或为 CGLIB 生成的子类注册相应的反射提示。

items.source: runtimeHints - the RuntimeHints instance to register the hints on
items.translation: runtimeHints - 要注册提示的 RuntimeHints 实例
